hooks.command:
f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/CONTRIBUTING.md"; m="The SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json could not deliver CONTRIBUTING.md from $f. Read it before changing anything in this repository."; n="CONTRIBUTING.md for this repository, injected at session start, up to but excluding the review checklist, which reviewers walk against a pull request's diff."$'

'; purl="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WisewareOrg/.github/main/PROCESS.md"; p=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$purl" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ]; then pm="$p"; else pm="Could not fetch PROCESS.md from $purl; read it before creating a branch or pull request."; fi; ps=$'

PROCESS.md (WisewareOrg/.github), fetched at session start:

'"$pm"; out=$(sed '/^## Review checklist/,$d' "$f" 2>/dev/null | jq -Rs --arg m "$m" --arg note "$n" --arg ps "$ps" 'if test("\S") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:($note + . + $ps)}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:($m + $ps)}} end' 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s' "$out" || printf '%s
' "$m$ps"
